typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	sFileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Agreement as string,
		PrincipalCode as string,
		{External ID} as string,
		Movement as string,
		Principal as string,
		Counterparty as string,
		CounterpartyCode as string,
		{Asset Class} as string,
		{Asset Type} as string,
		{Collateral Status} as string,
		{Instrument Id} as string,
		{Ticket Id} as string,
		Valuation as string,
		Currency as string,
		{Creation Date} as string,
		{Settlement Date} as string,
		{Nominal Amount} as string,
		{Reported Collateral Value} as string,
		{Reporting Currency} as string,
		Comment as string,
		{Settlement Comment} as string,
		Originator as string,
		Settler as string,
		{Pending Settlement} as string,
		Region as string,
		Group as string,
		UDF as string,
		{Issued Amount} as string,
		{Group Booking Collateral Value} as string,
		Difference as string,
		{IM Amount} as string,
		{VM Amount} as string,
		Prc_CONTRA as string,
		Cpty_CONTRA as string,
		{Base CCY} as string,
		{Instrument ID Type} as string,
		Event_Id as string,
		Fail_Age as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource	source(output(
		fileDate as date
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
FlatFileSource derive(loadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		IMAmount_Drv = toFloat(iif({IM Amount} == '', 0, toInteger(toFloat({IM Amount})))),
		VMAmount_Drv = toFloat(iif({VM Amount} == '', 0, toInteger(toFloat({VM Amount})))),
		FileDate_Drv = toString((substring(toString($sFileName), toInteger(locate('_', $sFileName, locate('_', $sFileName, locate('_', $sFileName, locate('_', $sFileName, 1)+1)+1)+1) + 1), toInteger(2)))) + '/' + toString((substring(toString($sFileName), toInteger(locate('_', $sFileName, locate('_', $sFileName, locate('_', $sFileName, locate('_', $sFileName, 1)+1)+1)+1) + 3), toInteger(2)))) + '/' + toString((substring(toString($sFileName), toInteger(locate('_', $sFileName, locate('_', $sFileName, locate('_', $sFileName, locate('_', $sFileName, 1)+1)+1)+1) + 5), toInteger(4)))),
		Valuation_Drv = iif(Valuation == '', 0, toInteger(toLong(Valuation))),
		Nominal_Amount_Drv = toFloat(iif({Nominal Amount} == '', 0, toInteger(toFloat({Nominal Amount})))),
		Reported_Collateral_Value_Drv = toFloat(iif({Reported Collateral Value} == '', 0, toInteger(toFloat({Reported Collateral Value})))),
		Issued_Amount_Drv = toFloat(iif({Issued Amount} == '', 0, toInteger(toFloat({Issued Amount})))),
		Group_Booking_Collateral_Value_Drv = toFloat(iif({Group Booking Collateral Value} == '', 0, toInteger(toFloat({Group Booking Collateral Value})))),
		Difference_Drv = toFloat(iif(Difference == '', 0, toInteger(toFloat(Difference)))),
		Fail_Age_Drv = iif(Fail_Age == '', 0, toInteger(toLong(Fail_Age)))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of FileDate_Drv} = toDate(FileDate_Drv, "MM/dd/yyyy")) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion,LookupLKPTABLE lookup({Copy of FileDate_Drv} == fileDate,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup filter(!isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(
		instrumentId as string,
		prcContra as string,
		originator as string,
		assetClass as string,
		loadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		principal as string,
		counterpartyCode as string,
		principalCode as string,
		settler as string,
		nominalAmount as double,
		currency as string,
		imAmount as double,
		vmAmount as double,
		group as string,
		eventId as string,
		issuedAmount as double,
		reportingCurrency as string,
		agreement as string,
		collateralStatus as string,
		baseCcy as string,
		cptyContra as string,
		groupBookingCollateralValue as double,
		externalId as string,
		settlementDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		fileDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		creationDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		instrumentIdType as string,
		assetType as string,
		valuation as integer,
		udf as string,
		pendingSettlement as string,
		reportedCollateralValue as double,
		counterparty as string,
		difference as double,
		comment as string,
		settlementComment as string,
		region as string,
		movement as string,
		ticketId as string,
		age as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		instrumentId = {Instrument Id},
		prcContra = Prc_CONTRA,
		originator = Originator,
		assetClass = {Asset Class},
		loadDate,
		principal = Principal,
		counterpartyCode = CounterpartyCode,
		principalCode = PrincipalCode,
		settler = Settler,
		nominalAmount = Nominal_Amount_Drv,
		currency = Currency,
		imAmount = IMAmount_Drv,
		vmAmount = VMAmount_Drv,
		group = Group,
		eventId = Event_Id,
		issuedAmount = Issued_Amount_Drv,
		reportingCurrency = {Reporting Currency},
		agreement = Agreement,
		collateralStatus = {Collateral Status},
		baseCcy = {Base CCY},
		cptyContra = Cpty_CONTRA,
		groupBookingCollateralValue = Group_Booking_Collateral_Value_Drv,
		externalId = {External ID},
		settlementDate = {Settlement Date},
		fileDate = {Copy of FileDate_Drv},
		creationDate = {Creation Date},
		instrumentIdType = {Instrument ID Type},
		assetType = {Asset Type},
		valuation = Valuation_Drv,
		udf = UDF,
		pendingSettlement = {Pending Settlement},
		reportedCollateralValue = Reported_Collateral_Value_Drv,
		counterparty = Counterparty,
		difference = Difference_Drv,
		comment = Comment,
		settlementComment = {Settlement Comment},
		region = Region,
		movement = Movement,
		ticketId = {Ticket Id},
		age = Fail_Age_Drv),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
